# MindLAB Neuroscience

> MindLAB Neuroscience applies Real-Time Neuroplasticity™ methodology to rewire neural patterns and achieve permanent behavioral change through evidence-based neuroscience coaching.

Founded by Dr. Sydney Ceruto, PhD in Behavioral & Cognitive Neuroscience, MindLAB Neuroscience offers proprietary programs (NeuroSync™ and NeuroConcierge™) combining neuroscience research with practical brain-rewiring protocols. The organization serves clients across multiple New York locations with one-on-one coaching, digital programs, and published resources including The Dopamine Code book.
